studies.def:
Combined with mig.dal (מִגְדָּל "Tower" H4026I)
This name means furnace, oven

κλίβανος, -ον, ό
(Att.., κρίβ-, but κλ- in Ion., Hdt., ii, 92), [in LXX for תַּנּוּר, Gen.15.17, Hos.7.4, 6 al. ;] 
__1. in cl., a clibanus, cribanus, an earthen vessel for baking bread. 
__2. In LXX and NT, a furnace (cf. MM, Exp., xv), an oven: Mat.6.30, Luk.12.28.†
(AS)
